cnc.title: CNC Processing
cnc.descriptionLong:
Our production capabilities are based on a machine park consisting of four CNC milling machines from the renowned Mazak brand — three 3-axis models and one 5-axis model. They allow precise machining of a wide range of components, ensuring high repeatability and excellent finish quality.

We operate a Mazak VTC 200B with X/Y/Z travels of 1120/510/510 mm, a 10,000 rpm spindle, a 1460 x 510 mm table, and a 24-tool magazine. Another machine is the 5-axis Mazak VARIAXIS 500/5X, enabling complex part machining thanks to 510/510/460 mm travels, a 12,000 rpm spindle, a 510 x 510 mm table, and a 30-tool magazine.

Our machine park also includes the Mazak VTC 200C, equipped with 1660/510/510 mm travels, a 10,000 rpm spindle, a 2000 x 510 mm table, and a 30-position tool magazine. The largest machine is the Mazak VTC-300C-II, offering 1740/760/660 mm travels, a 12,000 rpm spindle, a 2000 x 760 mm table, and a 30-tool magazine.

Such an extensive and diverse machine park allows us to complete both standard and highly demanding machining projects, guaranteeing top quality and precision.

aboutus1: Robmax is a company with a long-standing tradition – we have been operating on the market since 2005. Over the years, we have gained extensive experience that has allowed us to specialize in glass and metal processing, as well as to build a strong position in the industry due to our quality, timeliness and individual approach to every client.

aboutuspoint.1.1: Fixing plate for delivery vehicle floors
aboutuspoint.3.1: Side windows — single and insulated — for vans and agricultural machines

aboutus3: Thanks to modern technological facilities and an experienced team, we carry out both serial projects and custom orders tailored to client requirements.
aboutus5: We have: a press shop, a laser cutter, four Mazak CNC milling machines, and a powder coating plant. This allows us to precisely machine metal and complete even the most complex projects. Investment in modern machines ensures repeatability, accuracy, and high quality of our products.

whyuspoint.2: flexibility and individual approach to every project
whyuspoint.3: high quality confirmed by the trust of many partners
whyuspoint.4: modern machine park with Mazak CNC milling machines
whyuspoint.5: continuous development — we constantly invest in technology and the skills of our team

mask.about: Cover plates for the cargo strap mount in the floor, used in delivery vehicle conversions. Made of black steel, laser-cut, pressed, and powder-coated to ensure high product quality. We offer 8 standard models suitable for floors 9mm to 12mm thick, and we can also produce custom designs.
